# Tonix Pharmaceuticals to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 9, 2026


October 26, 2026 7:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_a9b9979dca7d9c633fdae783111aa54b/tonixpharma/news/2026-10-26_Tonix_Pharmaceuticals_to_Report_Third_Quarter_1646.pdf)


BERKELEY HEIGHTS, N.J., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (Nasdaq: TNXP) ("Tonix" or the "Company"), a fully integrated, commercial-stage biotechnology company, today announced that it will host a conference call and webcast to report third quarter 2026 financial results and operational highlights on Monday, November 9, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET.


To listen to the conference call, register at this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=g6C6Imcdj_9hEEJ8yBRCypNDHbNWdmRitxIuny059bl8tkF4y94nwc_qpfQwVSbW2jWKkthktGXhMTMpekgExx5x-L96xqq8uWHVavycXNNE6PqriZlsCy4Hs3n3IK750-oDZ75SlZNVDG0jiOJ6TQ4UaQ4ALlpZaAhTv0OEXDo=) . To view the webcast, register at this[link](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=g6C6Imcdj_9hEEJ8yBRCyib8hyOFN42kmQBOv8iuXfYSkMnTP-qT8tPybuiwyCIVexCuXXLTa7UfrmJf_QY4iyAU6428VY2WINSpVYuh-vY=) .


A replay will be available under “IR Events” in the Investors section of the Company’s website at[https://ir.tonixpharma.com/news-events/ir-events](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=R5jF4OtQIcFvg6Ny4QkWomI3loHeHqyeVtZGyLt4Tl2UujCSORZI0vZr65_6vBp38pbhsfnVE1v1AtIAr96ACF6_UxZjGSqezDS4u4T6NA-fvx2K_3foFumNYFjHMRB0I-c-HWUivp4JTgzIUlrJomMWHH08Th33aNjziBBKYMo=) .


**Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp.** Tonix Pharmaceuticals* is a fully integrated, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on central nervous system (CNS) disorders, infectious diseases, and immunology conditions with high unmet medical needs. TONMYA® (cyclobenzaprine HCl sublingual tablets 2.8mg), the Company’s flagship internally conceived and developed medicine, is the first treatment for fibromyalgia in more than 15 years. Tonix’s CNS commercial infrastructure supports its marketed products, including its acute migraine products, Zembrace® SymTouch® (sumatriptan injection 3 mg) and Tosymra® (sumatriptan nasal spray 10 mg). Tonix is extending the science behind TONMYA in Phase 2 clinical studies to evaluate the potential of TNX-102 SL in major depressive disorder and acute stress disorder/acute stress reaction. Tonix is also advancing a pipeline of infectious disease programs, including Phase 2-ready monoclonal antibody TNX-4800 (anti-OspA mAb) for Lyme disease prevention in the U.S., and TNX-801 (horsepox, live virus vaccine), a vaccine in development for the prevention of mpox and smallpox. Within immunology, TNX-1500 (anti-CD40L mAb) is a Phase 2-ready, third-generation CD40 ligand inhibitor for the prevention of kidney transplant rejection. To learn more, visit[www.tonixpharma.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=VLdN9fmhBQZp_o-xwO5wJ8_Hnu-ZnojZU-PYICiEE7pRUgOoMSVFJyaTrtT2H0Pp7YWC3qQwPBFz_mzEGwQd66WvFKFhyFCXoRw6h7PSbFc7HY4u-yQxBCwCBtx70ZfKc67QQFJw37i7wlKbZJUSZ_m_8aZE_mtEysl4lJx1059fgM2toDKPGK2QrAEtDKfo_gs_KmABCQv2uDVnO3dTwTvkjZkmoLpn3aYChQG4q_L_NeBU_SiQntdncemcUJD-M3p1jaxFKoiJuhIP9PwP3g==) .


*Tonix’s product development candidates, including TNX-102 SL for new, unapproved indications, are investigational new drugs or biologics. Their efficacy and safety have not been established and have not been approved for any indication.
